name: Thibaut Dubois
bio:
Thibaut's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly after a chance encounter with a Formula 1 mechanic during a family vacation in Spa-Francorchamps. Intrigued by the intricate teamwork and high-pressure environment, he shifted his focus from general HR to specializing in talent acquisition within the racing world. He started with smaller racing teams, quickly learning the unique demands of the industry before moving to Trackhouse Racing.

Thibaut's approach to HR is deeply rooted in understanding the technical aspects of the sport. He believes that a strong team is built on a foundation of mutual respect and clear communication. His ability to identify and nurture talent, coupled with his understanding of the motorsport environment, allows him to build high-performing teams. He prioritizes matching individuals with the right roles, ensuring that each member feels valued and contributes to the overall success of the team.

What sets Thibaut apart is his ability to balance empathy with pragmatism. He genuinely cares about the well-being of his colleagues, creating a supportive atmosphere where individuals thrive. However, he also possesses the firmness needed to make difficult decisions, always prioritizing the long-term health and performance of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Thibaut is of average height with a sturdy build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.
